text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The evidence directly supports the claim: RANKL signals from CD4+3− inducer cells act on RANK-expressing CD80−Aire− mTEC progenitors, promoting their maturation into CD80+Aire+ medullary thymic epithelial cells. The appearance of these inducer cells in fetal thymus is also temporally linked to the appearance of Aire+ mTECs, and RANK-deficient thymic stroma transplantation induces autoimmunity, implicating the RANK-RANKL axis in Aire+ mTEC generation.", "evidence_used": ["3952288"]}
